title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Vimal K. Vyas on 19.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 19/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 19.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 19/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 19.10.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Vimal K. Vyas would not be available.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Mr. Justice Hemant M.
Prachchhak) would take up the matters notified in the
Cause list of Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Vimal K. Vyas.)
By Order of Hon’ble Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
